Subject: Invoice acceptance checklist, EFT remit format, and VAT / tax evidence

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. As we get Redwood set up as a vendor in Horizon's AP system, can you confirm the precise invoice header fields and the EFT/bank remit format you require so our billing team can align? A few items we typically need clarity on: 

- Which PO field(s) must appear on the invoice (PO number, PO line, contract ref)?
- Does Horizon require net-30 / net-45 or milestone-based invoicing for platform subscriptions? Any preferred payment terms we should request on invoices?
- EFT/bank remittance format: SEPA/ACH routing fields, beneficiary name exact string you expect, and whether Horizon accepts beneficiary IBAN vs account/routing only
- Tax/VAT evidence: for US entities we typically provide W-9; for Horizon offices in the EU we can provide VAT registration certificate or self-cert. What document type do you need for Horizon's record?
- Any AP system constraints for invoice PDF naming conventions or line-item mapping (GL codes, charge types) that break ingestion?

I've attached a short sample invoice and our W-9 for reference. Once we have the required header/field spec we will update our invoice template and submit the vendor enrollment packet (we can complete Horizon's vendor spreadsheet if you prefer).

Next steps proposed: 
1) You confirm required fields and remit format by EOD Wednesday (8/19)
2) We return completed vendor enrollment + final sample invoice for test ingest
3) Horizon performs test/accept and confirms first payable invoice date

Thanks — appreciate the help getting this operational.

Subject: Re: Invoice acceptance checklist, EFT remit format, and VAT / tax evidence

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and a couple of follow-ups so your team can prepare the packet: 

- Required invoice header fields: PO number (exact match to our PO field), Invoice Date, Invoice Number, Supplier Legal Name, Supplier Tax ID (TIN/EIN or VAT), Invoice total (USD), and if present we accept a single column for 'Service description' + 'Qty' + 'Unit price'.
- PO field mapping: the PO number must be in the top-right of the invoice PDF and also in the invoice metadata (our portal reads both). If your submission creates a metadata key called "POField" that's ideal.
- Payment terms: Horizon standard is Net 45 for new vendor relationships; we can escalate to Net 30 for strategic vendors after the first two paid invoices. Please indicate "Net 45" on your invoices for now.
- EFT remit: We accept ACH for US vendors. Required ACH fields: Beneficiary name (exact legal name), Bank account number, Routing number (ABA), Bank name, Purpose code (if available). For EU payments we also accept IBAN+BIC. Please do not put intermediary bank details unless necessary.
- Tax evidence: For US entities we require a completed W-9. For vendors with EU presence we require VAT registration document and VAT number. If Redwood is US-registered with foreign branches, please provide both as applicable.
- File naming: please use format: REDWOOD_INV_<YYYYMMDD>_<InvoiceNumber>.pdf (no spaces). Our portal rejects files with non-ascii characters.

Attachments: I'm attaching the vendor-enrollment.xlsx Horizon template with required fields and a short checklist.

A couple of clarifying Qs: 1) Do you have a billing contact and a separate technical contact (for usage disputes)? 2) Do you offer consolidated monthly invoices for multiple subscriptions/accounts?

If you can return the completed enrollment and sample invoice by Wednesday EOD (8/19) we'll request a portal test and confirm expected first payment date.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Vendor Enablement Manager
Horizon Health

- Consolidated invoicing: Yes — we can produce a consolidated monthly invoice per master account that aggregates multiple customer projects; we'll mark line items with internal account codes so Horizon's GL mapping can split as needed. If Horizon prefers a per-PO invoice instead, we can do that too.

Hi Tessa/Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We ingested your sample invoice in a sandbox and have two minor issues to resolve before production: 

1) Your invoice PDF had the PO number in the top-right, but the OCR sometimes misreads bold fonts. Can you also add the PO number as plain text under the invoice number line (same exact PO string)? That guarantees portal mapping.
2) Our portal prefers the beneficiary name to be exactly the legal name on the W-9. Your sample used "Redwood Inference" but your W-9 lists "Redwood Inference, Inc." — please ensure invoices and ACH remits use the exact W-9 legal name.

If you can return an updated sample (rename per naming convention) we'll run one more ingest and move to production. Once we move to production initial payment will follow normal cycle (Net 45).

Regards,
